bio: Tao's has you covered if you are in the mood for Euro-Asian cuisine. The wide-ranging menu includes sushi and sashimi, steak tartare, poke bowls and dim sum, plus Signature Grill dishes such as Thai-style fillet of sea bass, lime, herbs, ginger, soy. The dishes are accompanied by a fantastic and extensive international wine list. A pleasantly relaxed yet stylishly elegant atmosphere prevails. In summer the cosy terrace is a huge draw, and there is also a bar....
